name: schedule_trigger
description: Manually fire a scheduled task immediately, bypassing its cron schedule. Use this when the CEO agent wants to test a job before its next scheduled run, or to force an out-of-band execution (e.g. 'run the ref scanner right now, don't wait until 3 AM'). The task must exist and have a registered executor handler. Returns a ReturnT with success/fail and the triggered log ID.

id.description: The numeric task ID obtained from schedule_list. Required.

executorParam.description: Optional override for the executorParam at trigger time. If omitted, the registered executorParam is used.
